programme.title: Licenciatura en Ingeniería en Ciencia de la Computación (grado: Licenciado(a) en Ingeniería en Ciencia de la Computación; 8 semestres; Facultad de Ingeniería)
programme.teaching_language: Spanish (not stated on the programme page; inferred from UC's B2 Spanish recommendation for foreign applicants to undergraduate programmes)
programme.campus: Campus San Joaquín (Vicuña Mackenna 4860, Macul, Santiago)
programme.how_found: Listed in the official 'Aranceles de pregrado Admisión 2026' table on admision.uc.cl; followed its link to the programme page. Chosen as the closest computer-science bachelor. Alternative: 'Ingeniería' (https://admision.uc.cl/carreras/ingenieria/, Bachiller/Licenciado(a) en Ciencias de la Ingeniería + título Ingeniero Civil, 11 semestres, arancel anual 2026 $10.260.000), where Computación is a major/diploma track rather than a separate admission programme.
programme.route: Admisión Especial y Complementaria – vía 'Enseñanza Media en el extranjero' (at least the last two years of secondary school abroad, last year no more than three years before applying, no university studies)
programme.quote: Licenciatura en Ingeniería en Ciencia de la Computación Pertenece a: Facultad de Ingeniería

value.spanish_level: B2 (CEFR) Spanish recommended, not mandatory; no English test required

english.quote: te recomendamos contar con un nivel de Español adecuado, idealmente, equivalente a un B2, para realizar tu programa de Pregrado o Posgrado.
english.how_found: Admisión Especial > 'Información para Postulantes Extranjeros' page, section '1. Nivel de Español B2'.
english.notes: Spanish proficiency is recorded here (teaching language is Spanish). It is a recommendation: applicants are invited to attach DELE, SIELE or an institutional letter, or take UC's online diagnostic during application. No English-test minimum is published for this route; the programme page only says the curriculum develops 'dominio del inglés en un nivel intermedio'.

value.description: No minimum grade average or test score published for this route and programme; minimum NEM averages (5.0 / 5.5 on 1-7 scale) apply only to Arquitectura and Kinesiología/Medicina/Nutrición/Odontología/Psicología. Admission decided by programme-specific evaluation (preselection, knowledge tests and/or interviews).

gpa.quote: Cada carrera dispone de su propio proceso de evaluación que puede consistir en preselección, pruebas de conocimiento específico y/o entrevistas personales.
gpa.how_found: 'Enseñanza Media en el extranjero' route page, sections Requisitos and Evaluaciones; cross-checked 'Requisitos adicionales por carrera'.
gpa.notes: Required documents include grades for the last three years of secondary school with grade scale and a class-ranking certificate (or proof the school does not rank). Caveat: the 'Requisitos adicionales por carrera' page lists for 'Ingeniería': 'Acreditar resultados PAES mediante Certificado'; it is not route-specific and does not name the Ciencia de la Computación licenciatura, while the route page lists only a CV for Ingeniería. Confirm with admision@uc.cl whether PAES is needed.

deadline.quote: 28 de septiembre al 28 de octubre del 2026 hasta las 13:00 horas.
deadline.how_found: Admisión Especial > Calendario, 'Ingreso Primer Semestre 2027', second application period.
deadline.notes: For March 2027 entry (primer semestre 2027). Two periods: first 24 Aug - 24 Sep 2026 (closed as of 2026-10-17; fee $107.230 external applicant), second 28 Sep - 28 Oct 2026 at 13:00 Chile time (fee $161.150 external applicant). Evaluations 16 Nov - 4 Dec 2026; results 28 Dec 2026. Vacancies page states all careers offer at least one vacancy for primer semestre 2027.

value.population: all undergraduates of the programme (no separate international tariff published)

tuition.notes: 2027 arancel not yet published as of 2026-10-17; 2026 is the latest. Additional one-off 'Derecho de Matrícula Único' 2026: $195.000 (aranceles-de-pregrado page). The aranceles table on that page renders with empty amount cells in raw HTML.

scholarship_exists.quote: Ser chileno o extranjero con residencia definitiva en el país.
scholarship_exists.how_found: Reviewed every scholarship listed under 'Becas de arancel' relevant to new students (Endowment UC, Cristóbal Conde, Cardenal Raúl Silva Henríquez, Extranjeros Francisco de Vitoria) and 'Otras becas UC'.
scholarship_exists.notes: No UC-run tuition scholarship found for which a foreign applicant living abroad without Chilean residency qualifies. Endowment UC requires Chilean nationality or permanent residency and FUAS; Cristóbal Conde requires 'Ser Chileno'; Silva Henríquez requires FUAS and Beca Bicentenario. The only foreigner-specific award, Beca Extranjeros Francisco de Vitoria, is for Derecho only and requires permanent residency in Chile and PAES.

scholarship_international.quote: Contar con permanencia definitiva en Chile.
scholarship_international.how_found: Beca Extranjeros Francisco de Vitoria page (the only UC scholarship aimed at foreigners), requirements list.
scholarship_international.notes: Even the foreigner-targeted scholarship requires Chilean permanent residency (and is limited to two Derecho places), so it is false for an applicant applying from Kazakhstan. Endowment UC similarly requires 'residencia definitiva'.

access_notes: All pages fetched as static HTML with curl; no blocks or logins encountered.
Aranceles de pregrado table (admision.uc.cl/.../aranceles-de-pregrado/) has empty amount cells in the raw HTML (amounts likely injected client-side); tuition taken from the programme page instead.
Teaching language not stated explicitly on the programme page.
